32: export function listMarkdownFiles(contentDir: string): string[] {
33:   if (!fs.existsSync(contentDir)) return [];
34:   const entries = fs.readdirSync(contentDir, { withFileTypes: true });
35:   return entries
36:     .filter((entry) => entry.isFile() && /\.md$/i.test(entry.name))
37:     .map((entry) => entry.name)
38:     .sort();
39: }

42: export function readPage(fileName: string, contentDir: string): Page {

54:     title,

**What was added:**

- `src/cli.ts` — `ssg serve` command with `--port`/`-p` option (default 3000), updated `USAGE`, and an expanded `parseArgs`/`main`. The `build` command is untouched.
- `src/index.ts` — exported the new serve API.
- Tests: `src/__tests__/serve.test.ts` (injection, static serving, MIME types, 404/403 path-traversal guard, rebuild on content/template change, reload broadcast, clean close) plus CLI parse tests. The old "unknown command" test now uses `deploy` since `serve` is a valid command.
- Dependencies: `chokidar@^4`, `ws@^8.21`, `@types/ws`.

Verified end-to-end: `ssg serve` starts on localhost, serves the built site with the injected reload script, rebuilds when a content file changes, and pushes the reload message to a connected WebSocket client.
